title: Some Spectral Properties of the $B_α$ Matrix of a Graph
summary: Recently, Samanta et al. introduced a unifying perspective to common graph-associated matrices through the matrix $B_α(G)=αA(G)+(1-α)L(G)$ where $α\in [0,1]$. We resolve an open problem regarding the positive semi-definiteness of $B_α$ and similar matrices. We also explore eigenvector properties of $B_α$ through edge and vertex removal. As a consequence, we provide a basis for results on the common graph-associated matrices.
